title: Show tool feedback in ork show and file a spec check's tool feedback
lead: *Proposed.* Depends on `ork-tool-feedback-file` and `ork-tool-feedback-ask`. `ork show RUN` lists each kept tool feedback entry with its filed item or its adj question, and a spec check files its own tool feedback through the same stateless filer.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft of S320 at f48a6154. `ork show RUN` prints findings with `filed as ID` (`internal/cli/show.go:206-220`) from `ShowReply.Findings` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:2863-2872`, `:3057-3058`); `ShowReply` has no tool feedback, and `docs/orchestrator-parity.md:148` marks v12.3 "not built". A spec check drops its tool feedback (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:424`, `:581`; `docs/design.md:1324-1325`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17, relay session 8d711f67): both extras (adj 417 `feedback.scope-extras`, `both`): `ork show` lists the entries with their filed item or question, and spec-check tool feedback is filed too. Targets, key and question follow adj 410-416 as in the first two slices.

What the code shows:

- `writeShow` prints `findings:` then one line per finding and `filed as ID` (`internal/cli/show.go:206-220`).
- `runSpecCheckOnce` parses the accepted report (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:417`) and then strips tool feedback with `splitToolFeedback("", text)` (`:424`); `SpecCheckConfig` carries `Project` and `Items` (`:45-52`). A spec check has no run record (`docs/design.md:1324-1325`).

*Proposed:*

- Wire: `ShowReply` gains `tool_feedback`, a list of `{n, role, tool, kind, proposal, filed, asked, error}` (`asked` the adj id).
- Text: after the findings, `tool feedback:` then one line per entry, `  N ROLE KIND TOOL  PROPOSAL`, then `    filed as ID`, `    asked as adj #ID` or `    not filed: ERROR`. Nothing is printed when the run has no entries.
- Spec check: at `:424` take the entries with role `spec-check` and pass them to `FileToolFeedback` with the check's project, item (the one item when the check has one, else none) and no run id; the outline says "spec check of ITEMS". Results are not stored; failures do not change the verdicts. The key keeps a retried check from filing twice.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestShowListsToolFeedbackWithFiledAndAsked` (`internal/cli`): a reply with entries filed `S500`, asked `#21` and errored `slicer add: exit 3` prints `tool feedback:`, three entry lines, and `filed as S500`, `asked as adj #21`, `not filed: slicer add: exit 3`. Fails first: `ShowReply` has no tool feedback.
- `TestShowWithoutToolFeedbackPrintsNoSection` (`internal/cli`): no entries, no `tool feedback:` line. Fails first only once the field exists; it guards the empty case.
- `TestShowJSONCarriesToolFeedback` (`internal/daemon`): a record with one filed entry gives `tool_feedback[0].filed == "S500"` in the reply. Fails first: no field.
- `TestSpecCheckFilesItsToolFeedback` (`internal/engine`, fake role and fake slicer): a spec-check report with a valid verdict and `tool feedback: 1. spec-check | tool: ork | kind: friction | proposal: P | evidence: E` runs `slicer add P --discovered-from ITEM --key tool-feedback-ork-...` and returns the same verdicts as without the line. Fails first: the line is dropped (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:424`).
- `TestSpecCheckToolFeedbackFailureKeepsTheVerdict` (`internal/engine`): a fake `slicer add` exiting 3 still returns the verdicts and no error. Fails first: no filing call.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and watch each go red.
2. Wire field and fill; text section.
3. Spec-check filing.
4. Docs: `docs/design.md` (spec-check filing, the `ork show` section; drop "not built"), `docs/orchestrator-parity.md` v12.3 to met, citing adj 417. Mark *proposed*.
5. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

UI slice: UI pass (r14). It changes `internal/cli` output.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- 'ork show RUN' for a run with tool feedback prints a 'tool feedback:' section listing each entry with 'filed as ID', 'asked as adj #ID' or 'not filed: ERROR'; a run without entries prints no such section.
- 'ork show RUN --json' has a 'tool_feedback' list with the same entries.
- A spec check whose role reports a 'friction' line files one slice in the target, and its verdicts are the same as without the line.
- Running the same spec check again files nothing new.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/cli ./internal/daemon ./internal/engine -run 'ToolFeedback' -v` lists the five new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n "not built" docs/orchestrator-parity.md` no longer matches the v12.3 row.
- [HUMAN CHECK] UI pass (r14): `ork show RUN` with three entries reads clearly at 80 columns.
